gates.why: Two branches that allocate the same requirement ID produce a merge conflict that cannot be auto-resolved; detecting the collision early costs nothing and prevents wasted review cycles.

never.rule: Delete or weaken a test to make CI green
never.why: A test deleted because it is inconvenient was the only record that something could go wrong. The fix goes in the production code, not the test suite.

never.rule: Mark a requirement accepted_gap without a written waiver
never.why: An unreviewed gap is an invisible risk; the requirement stays planned until a human writes the waiver and assigns accountability with a review date.
